stealth-detection.source: Detection_Test uses one d100 roll plus Detect. Detection_DirectObject tests strictly above 50 plus eight times the duration bonus and four times the corresponding loaded disguise/invisibility rank.
stealth-detection.runtime: ConcealmentDetection applies the strict contest to the live Disguise or Invisibility kind, and the reveal ends that state and restores the model while the other stealth kinds are excluded.
stealth-detection.test: StealthTests.ConcealmentContestUsesTheShippedStrictThreshold pins the equality and learned-rank boundaries. PR675 uses shared roll 32 with Detect +148 against ranks 22 and 50. Only the first mask drops; the ally and Shadow stay active. PR659 establishes the successful invisibility removal path. NPC execution and retail area admission remain separate. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/675#issuecomment-7065727166 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/659
